description: A personal link (valid 1-14 days, default 7) with which ONE person connects their OWN mailbox, calendar or meeting account — Google, Microsoft, or IMAP/SMTP — without a web login and without seeing anything else. The connected account belongs to that person. Meant for employees who only use WhatsApp: send them the link. Without user_id it is for the caller (e.g. the person writing on WhatsApp); for someone else tenant admin only. kinds: any of mail, calendar, meetings, files (default mail+calendar+meetings). Returns url and expires_at.

kinds.description: Account types the person may connect; default mail, calendar and meetings

name: create_connect_link
